feeds.title: Magic Mum
feeds.description: Founded by a mum and run by mums, MagicMum offers an online haven where Mums and mums-to-be can pop in for information, advice, support, friendly chat or a laugh!

feeds.title: Irish American Mom
feeds.description: A hundred thousand welcomes to the Irish American Mom website. I'm Irish. I'm American. I'm Irish American. Welcome to my melting pot. Sharing my recipes and ramblings from Ireland and America.

feeds.title: Her Family
feeds.description: HerFamily.ie is not just another parenting website, they are a digital lifestyle platform for the way parents really live today offering realistic support, practical content and sometimes, just a little light relief.

feeds.title: The Mamma Fairy
feeds.description: Travel obsessed working mum of two sports crazy boys, ages 9 and 6 who writes about the trials and tribulations of being a mum from random ramblings to guest articles in parenting publications both within Ireland and overseas. The Mamma Fairy Blog covers a whole range of parenting topics and issues but mostly our adventures of travelling with young kids.

feeds.title: One Yummy Mummy
feeds.description: I am Jolene Cox, award-winning food blogger and bestselling cookbook author. For the past 20 years, I have been developing and perfecting family recipes designed to take the stresses and strains out of everyday cooking. Enjoy new recipes, store your favourites, take inspiration and interact with a like-minded community.

feeds.title: Bumbles of Rice
feeds.description: I'm Sinéad, a mum of three from Wexford, Ireland. I've been sharing recipes, tips, and the ups and downs of parenting here since 2012. Expect humour and from the heart pieces, travel and recipes, with lots of keeping it real.

feeds.title: The Two Darlings
feeds.description: Mother, wife, PhD in Engineering, DIY enthusiast, blogger, dreamer. Blogging about style, beauty, creativity, kids and life!

feeds.title: Cuddle Fairy
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Cuddle Fairy. I am Becky O'Haire, originally from NY, I now live in the beautiful West of Ireland in County Mayo, with my husband, three kids and our sheepdog. We live a family lifestyle in the scenic West of Ireland. My blog covers a wide range of topics. For a particular subject, click one of these links: mindset, fashion, reviews, travel, recipes, parenting & blogging tips.

feeds.title: Irish American Mom Blog
feeds.description: A warmhearted personal blog by Mairéad, an Irish-born mom living in America, sharing nostalgic childhood memories, Irish heritage, simple family recipes (from Guinness stew to potato cakes), seasonal crafts, and the everyday joys of raising her children while staying connected to her roots.

feeds.title: everymum
feeds.description: everymum is Ireland's largest parenting community, supporting modern mums with trusted expert advice, community connections, free SuperValu gift bag vouchers, recipe guides, competitions, and developmental tools—rooted in a mission to make every mum feel supported, empowered, and never alone

feeds.title: Super Busy Mum
feeds.description: A UK Family Lifestyle blog based in Northern Ireland. Documenting family life, family travel adventures, free printables, recipes and more!

feeds.title: Mams.ie
feeds.description: Chat and support for pregnancy, babies, toddlers, kids, tweens & teens, plus fashion & beauty advice, competitions & more!

feeds.title: The Mammy Blog
feeds.description: A freelance writer and veteran blogger by trade, my name is Niamh O'Reilly and I'm the woman behind, Irish blog, TheMammyBlog.ie. Navigating the brand new world of motherhood with honesty, love, grace, and humor.

feeds.title: Pregnancy and Parenting Magazine
feeds.description: Pregnancy & Parenting magazine is essential reading for smart, savvy expectant and new mums looking for reassuring features, expert advice, celebrity trends, and lots of shopping pages.

feeds.title: Behind Green Eyes
feeds.description: I'm Sharon Leavy, from Co. Longford, Ireland. I'm married, and I have three young sons.I began this blog in 2011. Over the past eight years, I've written about everything from homophobia to nail polish, batch cooking to parenting. For the past couple of years, the blog has been centered around the books I read. I'm a voracious reader and am always happy to talk books with people.

feeds.title: Mum's Makeup Bag
feeds.description: I am Tracey. The title sums up the blog, I am a 39 year old mum of 5 and I have an unhealthy obsession with makeup. I am passionate about all things skincare and beauty, I am a marketer's dream when it comes to cosmetics, I will buy anything.

feeds.title: The S-Mum
feeds.description: I'm Maria Rushe; writer, Fitness Instructor and Educator. I'm a Mum of two busy girls and have been sharing the balancing act that is my life on my award winning blog for the past 6 years.

feeds.title: Saucepan Kids Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about inspiring parents and children through the family's journey around the exciting world of food and travel. They believe that a child who understands and appreciates the world and its food will live a happy, fulfilled and healthy life.

feeds.title: Mama Loves Ireland
feeds.description: Céad míle fáilte! A thousand times welcome! I am a travel loving Mama lucky enough to call Ireland her home. Let my articles help you plan your trip to Ireland and get ready to fall in love with the Emerald Isle.

feeds.title: The Life of Stuff
feeds.description: Edwina O'Connor launched The Life of Stuff in August 2012, as a creative outlet, and to share her passion, the stuff of her life - her adventures, interests and bits from her everyday life.From births to deaths, marriage to motherhood, The Life of Stuff still reflects Edwina's passion for life, and passions in life - and her grá for Irish culture, travel and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Wonder Care Blog
feeds.description: A little page to guide and support mothers and their babies through their first years! Practical and reliable hints and tips from a pharmacist mom!
